Iveta Dapkutė (born 29 January 1993) is a Lithuanian professional tennis player. Dapkutė has career-high WTA rankings of 728 in singles and 585 in doubles. She has represented Lithuania in the Billie Jean King Cup , making her debut in 2021 .
